2026-11-14.title: 考研撞期，给教授写信改约
2026-11-14.type: 考研英语 · 道歉信 · 完整原稿
original:
Dear Professor,
I must apologize for situation that I will not be able to visit you. I am writing this email in order to apologize for my mistake.

I have been looking forward to seeing you since we made the appointment. Unexpectedly, the time of postgraduate entrance exam is the same time that we settled. I have no choice but to cancel my travel plan. It's very regretful since I can't to visit you. If you are convince, I hope that we can change time after December 20 I finish my exam.

When we met next time, I'll bring a good news that I work well on exam. I'm looking forward to you reply.
yours,
Liming
2026-11-14.revised:
Dear Professor,

I am writing to apologize for not being able to visit you as planned.

I have been looking forward to seeing you since we made the appointment. Unfortunately, my postgraduate entrance exam is scheduled for the same time as our appointment, so I have to cancel my trip. If it is convenient for you, could we reschedule our meeting for a date after December 20, once I have finished my exam?

I hope to share some good news with you when we next meet. I apologize for any inconvenience and look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
grammar: 道歉的介词
apologize for situation
apologize for not being able to visit
apologize to + 人，apologize for + 事情或动名词。
情态动词
I can’t to visit you.
I can’t visit you.
can、could、must 后直接接动词原形。
礼貌改期
If you are convince
If it is convenient for you
convenient 是“方便的”。请求对方改期，可以说 If it is convenient for you, could we reschedule…?
不可数名词
a good news
some good news
news 不可数。一条好消息用 a piece of good news。
将来的时间从句
When we met next time
When we meet next time
用 when 引导时间从句时，可以用一般现在时表示未来。
物主限定词
you reply
your reply
reply 在这里是名词。用 your 修饰，整句是 I look forward to your reply.

studyNotes.heading: 大作文模板积累：七大方案与五大措施
studyNotes.intro: 今日学习：七大方案中的三种论证方法，以及五大措施中的个人、教育两个实施主体；同时整理措施段的开头、关联词和结尾。

items.name: 方案三：主语从句
items.template: It is widely acknowledged that + 完整句子。
items.example: It is widely acknowledged that college students face heavy academic pressure, which makes traveling an ideal way to relax and relieve stress.
items.note: 用固定句首引出观点；that 后接完整内容。

items.name: 方案四：Not only 倒装
items.template: Not only does + 主语 + 动词原形..., but it also + 动词...
items.example: Not only does traveling broaden students' horizons, but it also cultivates their independence and enriches their life experience.
items.note: Not only 置于句首，前半句部分倒装；does 后用动词原形，but also 后恢复正常语序。

items.name: 方案六：对比论证
items.template:
Compared with B, A can + 小方面, so as to + 大方面.
In contrast to B, the advantage of A lies in + 某方面.
items.example: In contrast to making friends, going sightseeing enables students to get close to nature and appreciate the beautiful scenery.
items.note: 通过比较 A 与 B，突出主要对象 A 的优势。

sections.title: 二、五大措施：今日学习 2 个主体

items.name: 个人行为（Personal）
items.template:
We should spare no pains to + 动词原形.
可替换：We should... / It is our duty to... / We are obliged to... / We ought to...
行动表达可替换：spare no pains to... / make concerted efforts to... / take concrete steps to...
items.example: Students themselves should make every effort to experience local culture and broaden their horizons.
items.note: 逻辑：个人主体 + 主动采取行动 + 实现具体目标。

items.name: 教育引导（Schools / Parents）
items.template:
Parents and teachers should set a good example for children in + 主题, through their own behavior.
Parents can serve as role models for their children by + doing...
Parents and schools should create more opportunities for children to participate in...
items.example: Universities should guide students to combine travel with learning.
items.note: 逻辑：学校、家长或老师作为主体，通过引导、示范或创造机会帮助学生成长。

sections.title: 三、五大措施的主体总览

items.name: 政府作为
items.template: 制定法律、制定政策、拨付资金。

items.name: 公民意识
items.template: 提高公众意识、培养社会责任感。

items.name: 家庭教育
items.template: 家长和老师以身作则、教育引导。

items.name: 开头：总结主题
items.template: We should bear in mind that 主题词 is of great importance to 某方面.
items.example: We should bear in mind that travelling is of great benefit to both our body and mind.

items.name: 措施一
items.template: For one thing, + 主体 + 措施。

items.name: 措施二
items.template: For another, + 主体 + 措施。
items.example: For another, students themselves should make every effort to experience local culture and broaden their horizons.

items.name: 结尾：展望未来
items.template: In this way, hopefully, we may have a better future.

items.name: 第二段：多点原因
items.template:
To begin with... / What's more... / Last but not least...
Firstly... / Secondly... / Thirdly...
To begin with... / More importantly... / Most importantly...

items.name: 补充与结尾
items.template:
Furthermore...（此外）
In this way...（通过这种方式）

original: I'm writing to apologize for you, because I cannot take the event as planned. I suddenly recived a notice that I be told to take an important interview. I hope you can understand my situation, and we can change a another day to meet.
Because of this interview is very important for my future career development, I cannot miss this opportunity
If you are convince, I hope that we can reschedule the meeting time after the interview
Once again I apologize for any inconvinence that I give to you, and I looking forward to your reply
Once again I apologize for any inconvenience I may caused to you, and I look forward to your reply.
2026-11-15.revised:
Dear [Name],

I am writing to apologize for not being able to attend the event as planned.

I have just been asked to attend an important job interview. Because the interview is important for my future career, I cannot miss this opportunity. If it is convenient for you, could we arrange to meet after the interview?

Once again, I apologize for any inconvenience I may have caused, and I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
grammar: 道歉的介词
apologize for you
apologize to you for missing the event
to 接道歉的对象，for 接道歉的原因。正式开头也可以直接说 I am writing to apologize for…
动词搭配
take the event / take an important interview
attend the event / attend an important interview
活动和面试都可以用 attend。说收到面试通知，可以写 I have just been asked to attend an interview.
because 与 because of
Because of this interview is very important
Because this interview is very important
because 接完整句子。because of 接名词短语，例如 because of an important interview。
礼貌改期
If you are convince
If it is convenient for you
convince 是“说服”。询问对方是否方便时，用 If it is convenient for you。
情态动词和完成时
any inconvenience I may caused to you
any inconvenience I may have caused
说可能已经造成的不便，用 may have + 过去分词。
look forward to
I looking forward to your reply
I look forward to your reply
要用 I look forward to 或 I am looking forward to。to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

2026-11-16.title: 越来越多人规律锻炼
2026-11-16.type: 考研英语二 · 大作文 · 完整原稿
original: I think that more people choose to exercise regularly relate the lifestyle changed. For past, people are busy to make ones living. They have to work hard all the time, even though they are on off work time. So, they have no time to exercise. Nowadays, the body health has been put on a more important priority. Since we can't deny that not only does exercise good for body and mental health, it but also gives the good feedback on work and study. As for me, I exercise regularly either. It gives me the power of control life, and brings me some place and time to slow down, which it is truly important to relax. It is a good sign that the growing popularity of exercise. We should spare no effort to encourage them to hang out. For one thing, government should place more gym zone, such like pocket park and run playground. For another, school and society should intrude people to build sort of mind. In that case, hopefully, our life would be better.
2026-11-16.revised:
I think that the fact that more people choose to exercise regularly is related to changes in lifestyle. In the past, people were busy making a living. They had to work hard all the time, even during their time off. So, they had no time to exercise. Nowadays, people give greater priority to physical health. We can't deny that not only does exercise benefit our physical and mental health, but it also helps us at work and in our studies.

As for me, I exercise regularly too. It gives me a sense of control over my life and gives me the time and space to slow down, which is truly important for relaxation.

It is a good sign that exercise is becoming more popular. We should spare no effort to encourage people to go out and exercise. For one thing, the government should provide more places to exercise, such as pocket parks and running tracks. For another, schools and society should encourage people to develop the habit of exercising regularly. In that case, hopefully, our lives will be better.
grammar: 主语从句与主谓一致
more people choose to exercise regularly relate the lifestyle changed
the fact that more people choose to exercise regularly is related to changes in lifestyle
the fact 作主语中心词，谓语用 is。be related to 后接名词短语。
过去时与动名词
For past, people are busy to make ones living.
In the past, people were busy making a living.
in the past 表过去，谓语用 were。be busy doing sth.，make a living。
Not only 置首倒装
Not only does regularly exercise benefits our body and mental health, but it also newly acquire us a control over the life
Not only does regular exercise benefit our physical and mental health, but it also gives us a sense of control over our lives.
regular 修饰名词 exercise。does 后用 benefit，but also 后的分句用正常语序。
肯定句中的“也”
I exercise regularly either.
I exercise regularly too.
肯定句用 too，either 常用于否定句。
Only by 置首倒装
Only by keep regular exercising, we have a health body and a positive life altitude
Only by keeping up regular exercise can we have a healthy body and a positive attitude toward life.
by 后接动名词。Only by 置首时，can 提到主语前。healthy 是形容词，attitude 是态度。
举例搭配
such like pocket park
such as pocket parks
用 such as 引出例子。这里泛指多个公园，用复数。
